restaurantName: Sa Er Ta Dongxiang Shou Zhua
address: 103 Baohan Zhijie, Yuexiu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Tucked in an alley filled to the brim with halal restaurants, this two-storey establishment has a dining room on the ground floor and some private rooms upstairs. Lamb is big on the menu, such as the juicy boiled premium version, which is chopped into chunky pieces with skin on and bone in. Pair it with garlic for extra pungency. Heyan flat noodles and Dongxiang stir-fried chicken are also worth ordering. For drinks, the eight-treasure tea is a must....
pageTitle: Sa Er Ta Dongxiang Shou Zhua
